cross_repo_role: SDK-side fix for a gts-comand change (annotation_batch_workflow bindings, migrations 94/95 at eda4f9ca). Unblocks gts-guideline-agent's guideline_agent/annotation/publish.py, which calls push_graph; its sibling fhir_questionnaire publisher already hand-rolls the bind with raw requests.
description: push_graph is dead against any current control plane: comand's annotation_job_before_insert trigger requires a workflow binding on the batch and nothing seeds one for API-created batches, so upload_graph 500s and leaves an empty DRAFT batch. Add bind_workflow + list_workflows to the delegate and give push_graph the missing leg (resolve workflow -> create -> bind -> upload -> read back), resolving the workflow id rather than hardcoding it, and skipping the bind against pre-workflow servers. Also fix the read-back model: completed_jobs no longer exists server-side, having been split into resolved_jobs/accepted_jobs/rejected_jobs, so a successful publish currently ends in a pydantic validation error.
